item.title: $BTC is still holding its summer low. The August breakout fully retraced, and pr…
item.description: $BTC is still holding its summer low. The August breakout fully retraced, and price fell back to the June lows. It briefly wicked below this level twice, but every daily candle has closed above. Buyers are defending this level.

item.title: Rumors of AI labs cracking public-key cryptography have put $BTC key exposure in…
item.description: Rumors of AI labs cracking public-key cryptography have put $BTC key exposure in focus. 7.12M BTC now rests on addresses whose public keys are already visible on-chain. The balance sits at a record high, climbing almost uninterrupted since late 2023 alongside price.

item.title: Bitcoin is trading in a short gamma zone. Options dealers cushioned price in Oct…
item.description: Bitcoin is trading in a short gamma zone. Options dealers cushioned price in October. Between $58K & $64K, they now sell as it falls and buy as it rises. This can speed up moves. More on capitulation, leverage and US buyers in this week's Week On-chain.

item.title: Bitcoin losses are the heaviest since FTX. Set against the money that flowed int…
item.description: Bitcoin losses are the heaviest since FTX. Set against the money that flowed into Bitcoin over the past year, they have almost doubled in a week. Spikes like this often came close to past lows, but some came early. More on past bear market lows in this week's Week On-chain .

item.description: Bitcoin is back at its summer lows near $60K, and stocks are also in a downtrend. BTC gave back the whole NVIDIA rally in less than six hours, an indication of severe relative weakness. More on capitulation and leverage in this week's Week On-chain .

item.title: $BTC miners are switching machines off. The hash rate sits 8% below last year's …
item.description: $BTC miners are switching machines off. The hash rate sits 8% below last year's level, the first annual decline since the 2021 China ban. That drop was forced by policy; this one is price-driven, with hash price at an all-time low.
